create_ScaleFactor_module: create a ScaleFactor module to scale PyTorch tensors by a learned scalar factor
fit_ScaleFactor_with_context: fit a ScaleFactor using fit_context_ to compute variance ratio from input and output observations
observe_ScaleFactor_variances: observe input and reference tensor variances with _observe to accumulate statistics for fitting
set_ScaleFactor_value: set the scale_factor parameter value directly using set_ with a float or tensor
reset_ScaleFactor: reset a fitted ScaleFactor back to zero using the reset_ method
